    readonly type: "object";
    readonly properties: {
        readonly request_id: {
            readonly type: "string";
            readonly minLength: 1;
            readonly maxLength: 200;
        };
        readonly code_root: {
            readonly type: "object";
            readonly properties: {
                readonly workspace_id: {
                    readonly type: "string";
                    readonly minLength: 1;
                    readonly maxLength: 200;
                };
            };
            readonly required: readonly "workspace_id"[];
            readonly additionalProperties: false;
        };
        readonly materials: {
            readonly type: "array";
            readonly maxItems: 30;
            readonly items: {
                readonly type: "object";
                readonly properties: {
                    readonly ref: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
                    readonly title: {
                        readonly type: "string";
                        readonly maxLength: 500;
                    };
                };
                readonly required: readonly ("title" | "ref")[];
                readonly additionalProperties: false;
            };
        };
    };
    readonly required: readonly ("request_id" | "materials" | "code_root")[];
    readonly additionalProperties: false;
};

export declare const ONBOARDING_TAKE_MATERIALS_MAX = 30;

export declare const ONBOARDING_TAKE_RESULT_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export interface OnboardingCodeRootTake {
    readonly request_id: string;
    readonly code_root: {
        readonly workspace_id: string;
    };
    readonly materials: ReadonlyArray<{
        readonly ref: MaterialRef;
        readonly title: string;
    }>;
}

export interface OnboardingTakeResult {

        readonly item_id: string;
        readonly title: string;
    } | null;
}

export interface PluginOnboardingDeclaration {
